CURRENT SCENE:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

ITEMS:

[I261] 他不知道【如果】这把花对你的身体好   correction: 如果 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 不要在“不知道”后用如果引导间接疑问
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-这些植物]对身体好处
  her past correction: 他都不知道什么植物[让他生病了→会让他生病] — her note: not occur yet, no了
  her past correction: 这些植物对身体[+有]好处

[I262] 他不知道如果这把花对【你的】身体好   correction: 你的 → 他的   strength: error
  checker's note: refers to Shennong's body, not the listener's
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-这些植物]对身体好处
  her past correction: 他都不知道什么植物[让他生病了→会让他生病] — her note: not occur yet, no了
  her past correction: [+要不要吃，]这就要看对你的身体有没有好处了 — her note: add a condition “要不要吃“ before “这就要看……了”

[I263] 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体【好】   correction: 好 → 好不好   strength: error
  checker's note: indirect yes/no question needs 好不好
  rule card (condition_not_definite, Coherence: connectors): Before 这就要看……了, state a not definite condition or alternative, such as 会不会生病, 要不要吃, or 蘑菇能不能吃.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: Before 这就要看……了, add a not definite condition or alternative, such as <condition>.  Her terms: not definite condition, 这就要看……了
  her past correction: [+要不要吃，]这就要看对你的身体有没有好处了 — her note: add a condition “要不要吃“ before “这就要看……了”
  her past correction: [-这些植物]对身体好处
  her past correction: 他都不知道什么植物[让他生病了→会让他生病] — her note: not occur yet, no了

[I264] 这就要【看】如果这把花毒不毒了   correction: 看 → 看到   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train)
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 和这个花[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 正好看到了[毒植物→有毒植物]
  her past correction: [-和]这个花是毒 — her note: 和cannot connect clauses

[I265] 这就要看【如果】这把花毒不毒了   correction: 如果 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 看后面直接用“毒不毒”
  rule card (he_scope_coordination, Coherence: connectors): 和/跟 + noun connects multiple nouns that share the same action. Do not use 和/跟 to connect clauses, verb phrases, or adjectives; if the noun is an accompanying object and does not do the action, use V.着 instead.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 和/跟 cannot connect <clauses/verb phrases/adjectives>. Use <correct connector or structure> instead.  Her terms: 和cannot connect clauses, 和cannot link clauses, 和cannot connect verb phrases, 和cannot connect Adj., 跟/和+noun., 和+noun., V.着
  her past correction: [-和]这个花是毒 — her note: 和cannot connect clauses
  her past correction: 和这个花[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 看看[如果→是]毒还是药 — her note: the “if” in “see if + clause” is not 如果

[I266] 这就要看如果这把【花】毒不毒了   correction: 花 → 烟   strength: suggestion
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 和这个花[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: [-和]这个花是毒 — her note: 和cannot connect clauses
  her past correction: 看看[如果→是]毒还是药 — her note: the “if” in “see if + clause” is not 如果

[I267] 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒【了】   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: no sentence-final 了 is needed here
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 和这个花[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: [-和]这个花是毒 — her note: 和cannot connect clauses
  her past correction: [是毒的花→有毒的花]

[I268] 神农不知道他【吃不吃】灵芝或者夹竹桃   correction: 吃不吃 → 吃的是   strength: error
  checker's note: identifying which flower it was needs 是
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: 神农[吃→吃了]一个夹竹桃 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农[吃→吃了]灵芝以后 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农和他的城市不知道什么植物[-他们]可以吃

[I269] 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝【或者】夹竹桃   correction: 或者 → 还是   strength: error
  checker's note: use 还是 for alternatives in an embedded question
  rule card (near_synonym_precision, Vocabulary): Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <correct> because it means <intended meaning/context>; <wrong> is used for <different meaning/context>.  Her terms: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农[吃→吃了]一个夹竹桃 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农[吃→吃了]灵芝以后 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 他应该给神农吃吧？朋友说：“这就要看灵芝是不是[特别→有用]了 — her note: 是不是有用了。比方说is used to express “for example”, delete it

[I270] 【别的人】给了神农一个灵芝   correction: 别的人 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 别的人 -> (delete) (corrected 8/8 in train)
  rule card (other_vs_additional, Vocabulary): 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this means an additional/another <noun>, so use 另外, not 别的.  Her terms: 别的, 另外
  her past correction: 神农[问人帮他→请人]给他灵芝 — her note: the “ask” in “ask for help” is not问
  her past correction: 他给[+了]神农灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: ”他们[给→给了]神农灵芝 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: After 不知道, use the indirect question directly; do not add 如果 here.
This refers to Shennong’s body, so use 他的, not 你的.
This is an indirect yes/no question, so use 好不好 rather than the definite 好.
Here 这就要看 means “it depends on,” so use 看, not 看到. 看look vs. 看到see: 看到 is for actually seeing a result.
After 看, use the question directly: 毒不毒. Do not use 如果 here.
It would be more natural to say 烟 here, since 毒不毒 commonly describes this item in this context.
毒不毒 is a question about a state, not a completed action or change, so no sentence-final 了 is needed.
You are identifying which plant he ate, so use 吃的是.
Use 还是 for alternatives inside an embedded question. 或者 is used for alternatives in statements.
The giver is already clear, so delete 别的人; Chinese can use a zero subject here.
